mechanism: St. John's wort induces CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2C9), potentially reducing sulfasalazine metabolite levels and efficacy, while sulfasalazine may affect folate metabolism which St. John's wort can also influence.
action: Monitor for reduced efficacy of sulfasalazine in inflammatory bowel disease or rheumatoid arthritis; consider alternative herbal supplements or increased sulfasalazine monitoring; counsel patient on potential treatment failure.
